name: Dove Conditioner Hair fall Rescue 170ml | Bangladesh
description:
Dove Hair Fall Rescue Conditioner – 170ml | Bangladesh

Strengthen and protect your hair with Dove Hair Fall Rescue Conditioner, specially formulated to nourish from root to tip and reduce hair fall by up to 98%. Infused with Nutrilock Actives, this gentle conditioner fortifies strands, making hair visibly fuller, healthier, and stronger with every wash.

Key Features:

Reduces Hair Fall: Up to 98% less hair fall with regular use

Deep Nourishment: Repairs and strengthens damaged hair from root to tip

Nutrilock Actives: Locks in essential nutrients for long-lasting hair health

Fuller, Stronger Hair: Improves hair density and resilience

Everyday Care: Gentle formula suitable for daily use

Net Volume: 170ml
Country of Origin: Bangladesh
